title: Review Finding
description: A single review finding emitted by /review-skill or /review-agent multi-perspective merge. Authoritative shape produced by scripts/merge_findings.py — synthesize_binary_findings() and layer0_dedup().

id.description: Stable canonical identifier — byte-identical across runs by construction. Format: '{checklist_item}:{path}:{dimension}/v{n}' for deterministic findings; perspective-emitted findings use checklist_item-based ids after canonicalization.

severity.description: Canonical case — 'High'/'Medium'/'Low'. Off-spec spellings ('HIGH', 'high') are normalised to Low at merge time before this schema applies.

evidence.description: Concrete quote, line cite, or pattern match — never abstract reasoning.

primary_focus.description: True when this finding is in the perspective's primary-focus list per agents/review-perspective-*.md ownership tables.

owner_conflict.description: True when ≥2 perspectives flagged the same item with different owners — surfaced separately for reviewer triage.

path.description: Path to the artifact (relative to repo root).

line_range.description: String, not number — empty when not line-anchored, or e.g. '12-18'.

validation.description: Concrete re-check the reviewer can perform to confirm the fix landed.

perspective.description: Which perspective emitted this finding. 'binary-evaluator' marks deterministically synthesized findings.

perspectives.description: Set when ≥2 perspectives independently flagged the same finding (post-dedup).

then.description: High-severity findings must include non-empty Current/Recommended blocks for the apply pipeline. Empty strings would slip past the bare `required` check while violating the apply contract.
